name: Burhi Gandak

source.name: Someshwar hills, near Chautarwa Chaur, Bishambharpur

did_you_know: Also called the Sikrahna in its upper reaches, the river takes the name Burhi ("Old") Gandak only after the Dhanauti river joins it near Motihari — the name marks it as an ancient, now-shifted channel of the neighbouring Gandak.
The Burhi Gandak is rain-fed rather than glacier-fed, unlike the true Gandak it flows parallel to — making it far more prone to sudden, severe monsoon flooding across northern Bihar.
